statement.zh: 在水平路径上，每个主张都算作活的扩展恰是扩大能形成者（按定义：Extension 在此展开为 Widens）；把“更好”读作扩大，C 对 living 的每种读法成立，不用公理；扩大之为更好的根据开放。
statement.en: On level paths, an extension in which every claim counts as living is exactly a widening of what can form, by unfolding Extension there into Widens; with “better” read as widening, C holds for every reading of living, with no axiom; that widening is better is an open warrant.

claim.zh: 在依存网的水平路径框架（Web.paths）上，主张是（形成，步），一条水平路径实现它恰当在该步接纳该形成。以每个主张都算作活，水平路径 l 对 l′ 的扩展（Extension：实现 l′ 实现的每个主张，并多实现一个）恰是 l 扩大 l′，即包含且超出它（Web.paths_extension_iff_widens）。对 living 的任何读法，扩展都是以每个主张为活的扩展，所以以“更好”读作扩大，C（每个扩展都更好）成立（Web.paths_comparison_widens），不用公理。在延续条件之下，扩大就是保留且增加有意义者（Web.widens_iff_retains_adds，见 significance-retained-within-margin），所以水平路径上由延续条件推出的 C（Web.paths_livingSignificance_comparison，见 one-axiom-yields-g0）是它在意义上的读法。三者是同一个对象，即接纳（Web.paths_one_object）：延续条件是水平路径上以每个主张为活、以从每个立场的意义为相关的生命意义；C 在那里计入每个主张的延伸就是扩大；在条件之下，扩大就是从任一立场保留并增加有意义者。条件定哪些接纳计入；读作扩大的 C 为它们定次序。
claim.en: On the frame of a web's level paths (Web.paths), claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step. With every claim counting as living, an extension of l′ by l (Extension: realizing every claim l′ realizes, and one more) is exactly l widening l′, including and exceeding it (Web.paths_extension_iff_widens). For any reading of living, an extension is an extension with every claim living, so with “better” read as widening, C, that every extension is better, holds (Web.paths_comparison_widens), with no axiom. Under the continuation condition, widening is retaining and adding what has significance (Web.widens_iff_retains_adds, see significance-retained-within-margin), so the C the continuation condition gives on level paths (Web.paths_livingSignificance_comparison, see one-axiom-yields-g0) is its reading in significance. The three are one object, admission (Web.paths_one_object): the continuation condition is living significance on level paths with every claim living and significance from every standpoint as the relevance, C's extension there with every claim counted is widening, and under the condition widening is retaining and adding what has significance from any standpoint. The condition fixes which admissions count; C read as widening orders them.

hypotheses.zh: 水平路径的框架（Web.paths）：主张是（形成，步），水平路径实现它恰当在该步接纳该形成；比较在任意两条水平路径之间。
hypotheses.en: The frame of level paths (Web.paths): claims are pairs of a formation and a step, and a level path realizes one exactly when it admits the formation at that step; the comparison is between any two level paths.

hypotheses.zh: “更好”读作扩大能形成者（Web.Widens）；C 在这一读法下是定理，“更好”另作他读或在一般的框架上，C 仍是前提。
hypotheses.en: “Better” is read as widening what can form (Web.Widens); C is a theorem on this reading, and remains a premise where “better” is read otherwise or on a general frame.

hypotheses.en: Discrete steps; natural-number levels and needs.

correspondence.zh: Ren 2026-10-11 问：“can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?”，并定：“as long as the derivation of the rules doesn't rely on axiom, don't use one”。AI 的读法：扩大读“leads to more futures”，Ren 已确认可能性读作接下来能形成的；当下能形成者是生成的空间，部分在其中扩大它之处是 Ren 那句话所说的区域（D22，经修订由 Ren 2026-10-18 取）。依 Ren 的交托，“flourishes/plurality”由扩大读出，多样性是尚未度量的一面；扩大比较生生的方向，生生是生成者生成新的生成（D1 与 D22，经修订由 Ren 2026-10-18 取）。
correspondence.en: Ren asked on 11 October 2026: “can we reduce is "for anything, its continuation into the future leads to more futures(flourishes/plurality) from generatively" - so we can be like "these are space where generatively happens", which allows us to derive everything without axiom?”, and decided: “as long as the derivation of the rules doesn't rely on axiom, don't use one”. The AI's reading: widening reads “leads to more futures”, Ren having confirmed that possibilities are what can form next; what can form now is the generative space, and where a part widens it is the region Ren's sentence names (D22, revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026). On Ren's delegation “flourishes/plurality” is read by widening, plurality an aspect not yet measured; widening compares the direction of 生生, which is generation generating generation (D1 and D22, revised and taken by Ren on 18 October 2026).

detail.en: There, with the axiom as a condition, C holds on level paths with retaining and adding what has significance as “better” (Web.paths_livingSignificance_comparison); here, with no axiom, with widening as “better”, the two being the same under the axiom.

detail.zh: 扩大不为每对水平路径定序：输送者的部分使两条路径混合（Transfer.mixed，见 four-cases-of-a-part）。
detail.en: Widening does not order every pair of level paths: the conveyor's part leaves the two paths mixed (Transfer.mixed, see four-cases-of-a-part).

limitations.zh: C 在这里按定义在水平路径框架上成立，“更好”读作扩大；在一般的框架上，或“更好”另作他读时，C 仍是前提。扩大是偏序，混合的部分不被定序，定序需要度量。把扩大称作“更好”的规范根据开放（章节 §8）：还原之后，公理的不变之步成为称生成的空间为好的内容。把扩大读作 Ren 的“更多的未来”与生生是 AI 的读法，依 Ren 的交托采用。不含伦理谓词。
limitations.en: C holds here by definition on the frame of level paths, with “better” read as widening; on a general frame, or with “better” read otherwise, C remains a premise. Widening is a partial order: mixed parts are not ordered, and ordering them needs a measure. The normative warrant for calling widening “better” is open (chapter section 8): after the reduction, the axiom's step of invariance becomes the content of calling the generative space good. Reading widening as Ren's “more futures” and as 生生 is the AI's reading, adopted on Ren's delegation. No ethical predicate occurs.
